title: Renowned Japanese culinary researcher Tatsuko Tatsumi passes away at 101
summary: The gastronomic expert, famous for her work on medicinal soup and her defense of life, died at the age of 101.

title: Wife of Hokkaido Shimbun journalist detained in Russia pleads for his release
summary: The distressed woman published an emotional testimony asking authorities to return her beloved husband safe and sound to their young daughter.

title: Bank of Japan shows openness to accelerating the pace of interest rate hikes
summary: A senior official at the Japanese central bank indicated that the institution will respond agilely to any inflationary uptick.

title: Shohei Ohtani plans to continue his two-way role in Major League Baseball
summary: The Japanese star commented that there are several tactical schemes to maintain his successful performance both from the mound and at bat.
